fit_side_length_why: v3 proxy gate (sha 92e56d17, regenerated from symmetric views): side length / front height 0.671 vs the sheet's 0.628 (+6.9 %): Y scaled x 0.9355 to the sheet (the side view is the truest view)
refloor_why: v3: no refloor, no rescale. sheet_proxy's floor (the lowest vertex) is a TALON tip of the -x foot (-0.39, -0.96, 0.000); the mirrored +x talon (0.36, -0.96) sits at z 0.035 (the generation's own tiny stagger, 0.6 % of the height; left as generated, no repose); the lowest cloak blade tips hang at z 0.65..0.70. Height 6.234 u = the sheet front height 6.24 within 0.1 %

dense.why: the head: straight hooked beak (x -0.25..0.25, y down to -2.0, lower tip z 4.7), both eyes and the hooded crest (top z 6.23) (proxy sha 92e56d17, stage-1 frame after the side-length fit); vg_weight 0.3 so the eye / pendant boxes below sit denser

v3 run 1: both feet (talons x |0.3..1.4|, front tips y -0.96, hind toe y +1.3, z < 0.45): at the base density the decimation shortened the +x talon tips asymmetrically (lowest +x talon z 0.089 vs the proxy 0.035; -x 0.000), so the feet hover; held as dense as the head so the talons (sheet: 'thick, sharp talons') keep their tips on both sides
the -x eye (pale almond x -0.44..-0.27, y -1.33..-1.07, z 5.32..5.45; centre (-0.377, -1.231, 5.374)): held dense so the painted rim / sclera / iris / pupil land on separate faces
the +x eye (the mirror of the -x box; pale almond x 0.27..0.44): held as dense as the -x eye

the throat pendant clasp (knob x -0.06..0.06, y -1.56..-1.45, z 4.28..4.39 + its V-strap) under the painted diamond decal (x +-0.16, z 4.10..4.58): held dense so the diamond outline survives the decimation (vulture_creature pendant lesson)

light.ao_why: AO baked on the watertight low itself: the feather-cloak soup has inner shells that black-hole AO rays (crystal_canine / vulture_creature lesson)
light.ao_distance_why: about one feather-blade width: real crevices (under the beak, between cloak and legs) darken, the broad cloak does not (storm_bear / batch lesson: AO darkens the basecolor below the sheet)
light.ao_fill_below_why: AO texels < 0.04 (bake origins between fused feather blades where every ray is occluded) refilled from their valid neighbours (vulture_creature / spike_beak idiom)
light.bake_drop_interior_why: proxy faces with solid on both sides (inner shells under the layered feathers) left out of the bake source so the cage stays tight
light.uv_island_margin_why: the feather low unwraps into thousands of islands; margin 0.001 keeps the atlas texel coverage up (vulture_creature lesson)

recolour3d.name: blade_tips_steel_blue
recolour3d.why: v3: kept from v1/v2 (brief: 'blade-tip steel-blue tint as v1/v2'); the face (beak + both eyes) and pendant exclude boxes re-fitted to the new proxy. The new proxy's raw texture: blue tips 108,98,133 (L* 44, r > g: purple), feathers 51,44,56; sheet steel chip 97,102,127. v1/v2 note: UNIT NOTE (b): the sheet's blade-feather tips are STEEL-blue (chip 97,102,127; sheet blue pixels b* < -10: 9..14 % of the front / side masks, front body 92,92,117 L* 40.1, side 86,86,111 L* 37.6, hem up to 129,140,179); the proxy's blue texels are a darker PURPLE 53,48,72 (L* 21.5, r > g) and the proxy is bluer overall (b* p10 -14.7 / p50 -5.3 vs the sheet's -11.1 / -3.3). Only the texels at b* <= -14 (the sheet's blue share) go to 100,105,131 (the chip x1.03 for AO), the proxy's root-to-tip gradient kept (gamma 0.8, clip 0.45..1.4: the brightest tips land near the sheet's hem 129..140,140..147,179..183). Run 2 took every b* <= -10.5 texel (whole feathers, basecolor blue share 16.5 %, clip to 1.6) and read silver-steel all over. The face (beak + eye box) and the pendant are excluded; L* <= 60 keeps highlights / the pale sclera out

recolour3d.name: feathers_charcoal
recolour3d.why: v3: kept from v1/v2 (brief: 'blade-tip steel-blue tint as v1/v2'); the face (beak + both eyes) and pendant exclude boxes re-fitted to the new proxy. The new proxy's raw texture: blue tips 108,98,133 (L* 44, r > g: purple), feathers 51,44,56; sheet steel chip 97,102,127. v1/v2 note: tone (lesson: judge from the basecolor): run 1 basecolor L* p50 6.4 / p90 22.9 vs the sheet front mask 16.2 / 39.5; the proxy's violet-black feathers (b* -14..-1.5, a* 1.7..6.7) sample 22,19,25 (L* 6.5) on the body vs the sheet's charcoal 35..37,33..34,40 (L* 13.1..13.6; head 42..44,38..40,47 L* 16.5). Feather texels to 48,44,56 (the sheet charcoal 35..44,33..40,40..47 / 0.86 for AO, nudged toward the violet chips 64,59,77 / 75,73,81; run 3 at 44,41,50 left basecolor L* p50 11.1 vs the sheet 16.2), the proxy's feather shading kept (gamma 0.8, clip 0.3..2.5 so the blacks stay black). The neutral grey legs / talons (b* -1.5..0, L* 15..16 = the sheet's 15.8..17.7) and beak (b* -3..-0.5) fall outside b* <= -1.5 or the face box; the red iris (a* 42) and the pink scar (a* 15..26, b* > 2) are not selected

recolour3d.name: last_feather_px_blood_root
recolour3d.why: v3 (brief V3 (2), artist v2: 'make its last wing feather red so it looks like a blood soaked blade'): the LAST blade of the +x side = the outermost, lowest-hanging blade of the folded wing, the back-outer corner of the cloak (tip (1.456, 1.726, 0.702), the lowest outer tip; the other side's tip mirrors it within 0.012 u; the outermost blade in the back view and the trailing lowest tip in the side view). Its faces = the proxy faces within 1.25 u geodesic of the tip; its texels = texels within 0.006 u of those faces; each band tiled by spheres that hold >= 98 % blade texels of that band or a tip-ward band (greedy radii 0.06..0.008 u), so the neighbouring blades stay steel-blue / charcoal. Schedule (geodesic from the tip): edge 0..0.08 u 90,25,32; body 0.08..0.40 u 141,55,65 (sheet red chip) full; then strength 0.75 / 0.45 / 0.20 over 0.40..0.65 / 0.65..0.90 / 0.90..1.25 u, fading into the steel-blue / charcoal; the blade's own shading kept (gamma 0.5, clip 0.6..1.3). Paint only, geometry as generated; the same schedule on both sides

recolour3d.name: pendant_frame
recolour3d.why: v3 (brief V3 (3)): the throat pendant clasp, tan, on the midline. The new proxy built a small knob (x -0.06..0.06, z 4.28..4.39, front-most (0, -1.561, 4.337)) on a brown V-strap: it reads as a brown smear, not the sheet's diamond. Painted as a DECAL in front view (v1 unit note: 'paint it back as a small decal-like recolour3d at the sheet's position (geometry as generated)'): a diamond centred (0, 4.34), half-width 0.16, half-height 0.24 u (the sheet's diamond is 0.41 x 0.60 u on the regeneration's front view; 0.8x here so it clears the beak tip at z 4.7), frame 0.05 u wide in tan 160,136,124 (sheet frame 155,130,118 / chip 191,168,153, +~3 % for AO as v1); spheres tile the front-visible texels inside the diamond (>= 98 % purity, radii 0.04..0.006 u). The new proxy has no back clasp (back view: feathers only), so none is painted

recolour3d.name: pendant_stone
recolour3d.why: the diamond's dark stone (sheet centre stone 70,62,62) inside the frame (diamond metric <= 0.624), same tiling

recolour3d.name: eye_mx_rim
recolour3d.why: v3 (brief V3 (1): TWO red eyes, crisp, level, mirrored; artist v2 'should have 2 eyes', v2 face note 'the face looks crooked'). The new proxy has both eyes, level (head mirror p99 0.029 u), but they read pale / pinkish (sclera 171,156,175, a small 106,54,59 iris under the lid). One eye DESIGN, drawn on a z-buffered render looking straight into the -x eye (view dir (0.80, 0.55, -0.24) through (-0.377, -1.231, 5.374), 1000 px/u) and used unchanged for the +x eye (the mesh mirrored into the same camera): outline = the union of both eyes' pale almonds (+ the red under the lid), closed (r 0.025 u) and smoothed; rim = outline + 0.014 u band, dark surround 36,33,40; spheres tile each class's visible texels (>= 98 % of a sphere's texels in that class or an inner one; radii 0.04..0.004 u). Order rim -> sclera -> iris -> core -> pupil (-x eye)

rig.spine_why: v3 (stage-1 frame = final frame, no turn): spine on x 0 (body slab x mid -0.00..0.00 at z 2.0..5.8, mirror p99 0.041 u); neck root (0, -0.4, 4.7) behind the pendant; the head bone runs to the forehead (0, -1.1, 5.75) between the eyes (z 5.37)

chains.name: wing
chains.why: the feather cloak / tucked wings: shoulder to the back-outer wing tip (the red last blade, tip (1.46, 1.73, 0.70)); mirrored

chains.name: leg
chains.why: v3: hip (inside the cloak), heel (tarsus top z 1.3), ankle (z 0.42; tarsus grey centroid x 0.50..0.63), front toe (talon tips y -0.96); mirrored (the proxy legs are mirror pairs)

chains.name: tail
chains.why: a TAIL chain down the back of the cloak on x 0 (artist v2: turns are done by posing), so the tail feathers can be posed to either side

clips.why: PLACEHOLDER (movement + height are the open artist questions): idle = breathe 1.5 deg + the kit's cloak-wing sway; walk = a short stalking step (leg_swing 8: the kit's foot bend dips the toes below the floor at larger swings, storm_bear lesson)

_doc: v3 LIGHT finish of the REGENERATED Pixal3D proxy (symmetric views: front = the sheet's back silhouette mirrored, side + mirrored side; seed 56, sha 92e56d17; artist 2026-10-17 'the face looks crooked'): no turn, no repose (mirror p99 0.041 u whole body, 0.029 u head); recolour3d keeps the v1/v2 tone (steel-blue tips, charcoal), paints the two blood-red last feathers, the tan diamond pendant and the two red eyes. All points in the stage-1 frame (Y x0.9355 side-length fit, no refloor), sheet units.
